description: Configure a secure insurance claim portal in LimeSurvey. Log in (admin/Admin123!) and create a new survey titled 'Auto Insurance Claim Portal 2025'. Create two question groups: 'Incident Details' and 'Document Submission'. In 'Incident Details', add a Yes/No question (Code: HAS_EVIDENCE) asking 'Do you have photographic evidence of the damage?'. In 'Document Submission', add two File Upload questions: 1) 'Upload Signed Claim Form (PDF Only)' (Code: FORM_PDF) which must ONLY allow 'pdf' files and be limited to 1 file. 2) 'Upload Damage Photos' (Code: DMG_PHOTOS) which must allow 'jpg,png' files, be limited to 5 files, and MUST ONLY BE VISIBLE if the user answered 'Yes' to HAS_EVIDENCE. Finally, activate the survey.
